top_lighthouse_issues.title: Avoid an excessive DOM size
top_lighthouse_issues.description: A large DOM will increase memory usage, cause longer style calculations, and produce costly layout reflows. Learn how to avoid an excessive DOM size.

top_lighthouse_issues.title: Serve static assets with an efficient cache policy
top_lighthouse_issues.description: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. Learn more about efficient cache policies.

top_lighthouse_issues.title: Avoid long main-thread tasks
top_lighthouse_issues.description: Lists the longest tasks on the main thread, useful for identifying worst contributors to input delay. Learn how to avoid long main-thread tasks

top_lighthouse_issues.title: JavaScript execution time
top_lighthouse_issues.description: Consider reducing the time spent parsing, compiling, and executing JS. You may find delivering smaller JS payloads helps with this. Learn how to reduce Javascript execution time.

top_lighthouse_issues.title: Avoid chaining critical requests
top_lighthouse_issues.description: The Critical Request Chains below show you what resources are loaded with a high priority. Consider reducing the length of chains, reducing the download size of resources, or deferring the download of unnecessary resources to improve page load. Learn how to avoid chaining critical requests.
